what: Folded sentinel checks can remain permissive if they inherit the current bare token grep

suggested_fix: Make assert_folded_sentinel_writes match actual non-comment shell write lines like : > "$DESIGN_TMPDIR/.completed/step-X" inside the extracted host fence, then check source-env < write < pause-check

what: Existing fence scans only recognize unindented ```bash fences, but key target fences are indented
